news.title: Search committee seeks input on chancellor hire
news.summary_en: Virtual listening sessions will be held June 15 and 22 to gather UW–Madison community input.

news.title: Employee appreciation Ice Cream Social events
news.summary_en: Employee appreciation events will be held June 17 and 18 to thank all shifts.

news.title: Pay increase for UW employees to become effective June 28
news.summary_en: Eligible UW–Madison employees will receive a 2 percent wage increase under the 2025-2027 pay plan.

news.title: Four Northwoods towns unite to rebuild EMS — and cut response times in half
news.summary_en: With support from UW–Madison’s Wisconsin Office of Rural Health, Vilas County communities replaced a strained volunteer system with a 24/7 paramedic service.
